Alex K.: Pilot ended yesterday for Meridian. Need to wind down the pilot envs and rotate keys + drain dedicated pools. Timeline: asap this week. Any objections?
Meera S.: No objections. Quick checklist?
Jon P.: I'll own key rotation + hosted key invalidation. Tasha will handle dedicated pool drain and VPC cleanup.
Tasha: Yep. Plan:
- schedule pool drain
- move in-flight to fallback
- deallocate GPUs
- purge temp volumes
ETA ~4h.
Jon P.: For hosted keys use:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/rotate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -d '{"key_id":"meridian-pilot-key"}'
```
After rotation revoke old:
```
curl -X DELETE https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/meridian-pilot-key -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```
Meera S.: Data retention — logs/request traces are retained per contract (90 days). Anything else requires legal hold. @Priya L. PTAL.
Priya L.: No legal hold from our side. If customer wants exports we need a signed transfer sheet; otherwise proceed with standard retention and deletion after 90d.
Alex K.: Customer asked for export of embeddings. Jon, can you run export and hand off to Sales Ops securely?
Jon P.: Will run export job and stash in secure S3. Command:
`redwood-admin export --project meridian --dest s3://redwood-exports/meridian-pilot --include-embeddings`
ETA ~2h.
deploy-bot: scheduled drain job queued for pool 'dedicated-meridian-1' at 1798001200.
Tasha: started draining now, routing remaining traffic to hosted fallback :thumbsup:
Meera S.: Once drain + rotation + export are complete, I'll update the POC tracker and send final closure note to customer.
Alex K.: Please DM me with links and confirmations when done. Thanks team :rocket:
